title: Eczema (Dry Skin)
ayurvedicView: Eczema shows Pitta and Vata imbalance in the skin. Gentle care, moisturization, and cooling help heal.
remedies: Coconut oil or ghee applied to affected areas
Avoid harsh soaps and hot water
Neem and turmeric paste for inflammation
Short, lukewarm baths, patting the skin dry and moisturising straight after
seeDoctor: Weeping, crusted or painful skin that may be infected
Eczema that keeps you awake or does not improve with care
A sudden widespread rash, especially with fever
